title: The Discovery Call
sub: Before the demo. Find the operational friction that makes one3seven obvious — and talk less than half the time.

title: Open without pitching
displayText: Ask, then listen. The moment you pitch, they stop telling the truth.
say: Walk me through what happens when a potential client first reaches out.
note: A genuine question about their workflow — never a feature.

title: Learn how matters arrive
displayText: Map the front door — every channel arrives in a different state of mess.
note: Referrals, web forms, phone, walk-ins. Where does the burden start?

title: Locate the operational friction
displayText: Where does a human gather pay stubs, rebuild a timeline, chase documents?
say: When a matter comes in, who has to assemble the record before anyone can screen it — and what does that take?
note: Don't accept “it's fine, we manage.” Find the manual assembly precisely — it's exactly what we remove.

title: Identify who performs it
displayText: Paralegal, coordinator, or the attorney? That's whose pain you solve — and your champion.
note: The person doing assembly is the one who feels the relief first.

title: Quantify time, delay, abandoned effort
displayText: Hours per intake · days of back-and-forth · half-built matters dropped.
say: Roughly how long does that take per intake, and how many matters get half-built and then dropped?
note: Numbers make the problem real — and later they size the value.

title: What the attorney needs to see first
displayText: The 2–3 things that make or break a screening decision.
note: This is what the Decision Card surfaces — you're learning how to aim the demo.

title: Reflect the workflow back
displayText: Say their pain in their words — then you've earned the demo.
say: So today, your coordinator spends hours rebuilding a file before an attorney even looks — is that right?

title: Coverage Rate — the locked definition
displayText: Say it the same way every time.
say: Coverage Rate is the share of the firm's screening questions that the worker's submitted record can answer or meaningfully illuminate before staff reconstruction begins. It is not a judgment about whether the worker has a viable claim.

sources.label: one3seven canonical definition — Coverage Rate (locked language)

title: What Coverage Rate is NOT
displayText: Completeness against the firm's questions — nothing about the merits.
say: Our Coverage Rate tells you how likely the case is to win.
note: NOT: conversion rate · acceptance rate · win rate · case strength · document count. If a teammate implies it predicts case value, correct it on the spot.

title: Position one3seven narrowly
displayText: A narrow, true promise beats a broad, shaky one.
say: We organize the worker's record, we link every fact to its source, and the worker chooses who sees it. That's the whole claim.

title: Confirm the problem is meaningful
displayText: If they shrug, they may not be a fit — and that's fine.
say: If that assembly work disappeared, what would it change for your team?

title: Bridge into the demo
displayText: Tie it to what they just told you.
say: You mentioned your paralegal rebuilds every timeline by hand — let me show you exactly that step.
note: Now you run the 15-minute demo with their pain as the frame.

title: Agree on a next step
displayText: Firm code · pilot seat · follow-up with the attorney.
say: You're mapping a workflow and describing a record — never diagnosing a legal claim.
note: Locate the friction, and let the product do the rest.
